summary: Added scripts/systemd/install-moltbot-gateway-restart-trigger.sh (executable) to install restart-trigger systemd units via copy or symlink into ~/.config/systemd/user, run systemctl --user daemon-reload, and enable/start moltbot-gateway-restart-trigger.path. Included a built-in manual verification checklist covering unit activation, Telegram command trigger, log observation, restart confirmation, and request-file consumption. Validated script behavior with mocked systemctl in both copy and symlink modes and confirmed syntax with bash -n.
